title: The taxman’s sums didn’t add up when he tried to blow up Petrofac
summary: Petrofac's Asset Solutions wing was sold to CB&I, securing the future of its operations and the roles of many highly skilled workers, amidst a complex dispute with HMRC over liabilities.
sentiment_reason: The successful sale and resolution of the dispute, despite the challenges, is a positive outcome for the company and its employees.
